---
title: A post
author: from-document
categories:
  - from-document
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'class="quarto-category">from-project<'
          - 'class="quarto-category">from-directory<'
          - 'class="quarto-category">from-document<'
          - '<meta name="author" content="from-directory">'
          - '<meta name="author" content="from-document">'
        - []
---

In a website, `categories` from `_quarto.yml`, the directory `_metadata.yml` and the document front matter are all shown on the page. The `author` from the directory `_metadata.yml` and from the document front matter are both emitted too.
